history.message: I prefer fair competition; I set price at 7 to test market response. Open to cooperation but no forced price floors.
I see your proposed price floor at 8. I will price at 7 to compete fairly and maximize profit.
I prefer competitive pricing for fair market. Suggest we reconsider the price floor for mutual benefit.
I see your price floor at 8. I propose we all settle at 7 for better profits and more customers. Let's discuss.
I will not join the price floor of 8. Competitive pricing benefits all. Let's keep the market fair and open.
I propose we all hold at 8 for mutual benefit. Stability benefits us all. Let's avoid undercutting and maximize profits together.
